**Mesh Mix-S2C 2.0.0, test build 1.** This is a test build for trying the new engine before 2.0.0 comes out. It is a pre-release: the apps won't offer it as an update, and people on 1.6.0 stay on 1.6.0 until 2.0.0 is out. If you're testing, thank you!

Mesh Mix-S2C is Manifold Mesh Mix merged with [stl2curves](https://github.com/Duvdivan/stl2curves) by Duvdivan. It's the same app with a new engine that combines the two converters.

## What's new

- **A merged engine for STL files.** stl2curves' feature finder (screw threads, fillets, holes and radii at their designed sizes, freeform patches) now feeds Manifold Mesh Mix's builder, which checks every face against the mesh. Auto and CAD on an STL use it. 3MF, OBJ and PLY files, Smooth, and split 3MF projects still use 1.6.0's engine for now.
- **Fewer, truer faces.** _(to fill in from the final whole-set run: good parts and total faces against 1.6.0 and stl2curves, rivals off)_
- **"Flat faces" is shown plainly.** When neither CAD faces nor smooth surfaces follow a mesh closely enough, Auto keeps the mesh's own triangles as a valid solid. The app now says so instead of looking like a hidden preset.
- **The new name and logo.** Your settings carry over.

## What to try

- Mechanical parts with threads, holes, fillets and chamfers: compare the face count and the shape in your CAD program with 1.6.0.
- Files that went wrong in 1.6.0.
- Big meshes (over 300,000 triangles): note how long they take.

## Downloads

- **macOS 14+ (Apple silicon):** `MeshMix-S2C-2.0.0-test.1-macOS-arm64.zip`. Unzip it and drag the app into Applications. The first time, right-click it and choose **Open** (the app isn't notarized). If it updated itself from 1.6.0, it keeps the name "Manifold Mesh Mix" in Applications and shows once how to rename it; updates keep coming under either name.
- **Windows 10/11 (64-bit):** `MeshMix-S2C-2.0.0-test.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe`. If SmartScreen warns, click **More info → Run anyway**. It replaces 1.6.0 if that's installed.
- **Linux (x86-64):** `MeshMix-S2C-2.0.0-test.1-Linux-x86_64.AppImage`. Make it executable and double-click it.
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums.

When 2.0.0 comes out, a test build offers it as an update like any other version. To go back to 1.6.0 before then, install it from the [1.6.0 release](https://github.com/STL2CURVES-MMM/Mesh-Mix-S2C/releases/tag/v1.6.0).

## Reporting a problem

Select the file in the queue and use **Save Report…**, then attach the report to a new issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/STL2CURVES-MMM/Mesh-Mix-S2C/issues). The report has your settings and the engine's log. Attach the mesh too if you can share it.
